title: SensorReading
description: Envelope for one sensor reading, as produced by 02_sensor_simulation/sensors/*. Each sensor populates 'data' with its own fields documented in documentation/dataset_description.md.

frame_id.description: Coordinate frame or device identifier, e.g. 'camera_front', 'lidar_top'.

data.description: Sensor-specific payload (detections, point clouds, ranges, noise-corrupted signals, ...).
